Grand Admiral Zaarin used Heavy Lifter U3f14 to retrieve Rebel Alliance B-wings found carrying Mag-pulse Torpedoes during the "Arms Race." U3f14 took the captured B-wings disabled by Imperial Assault Gunboats back to XQ6 Platform Research.
